name: TeraGram
description: Here we present a massive longitudinal dataset of public Telegram content, comprising over 5.9 billion messages dating from 2015 to 2025, collected from 712 thousand channels and groups, enriched with metadata on forwards, reactions, and polls. The dataset spans multiple languages including Russian and Farsi, representing countries where Telegram shows mainstream adoption, as well as Western languages where Telegram is used in specific sub-communities. The dataset has several advantages.
